name: project-wiki
description: Karpathy-style LLM Wiki applied across all Claude Code and Cowork projects. Imposes a canonical project layout (raw/ + output/ + wiki/ + code/wiki/), maintains an Obsidian-compatible knowledge base, takes over existing project conventions cleanly, and snapshots the wiki into code/wiki/ on /go-to-code. Default policy is curate-to-wiki: Claude writes to output/ freely, but wiki/ entries go through a mandatory wiki-curator gate. Fourteen layered skills inheriting from skill-architect's foundation abstracts.
